plan.notes: Source is AUM's institution-published 'Four-Year Flight Plan' for General Business (document stamped 'Updated 10/26/2020', currently published on aum.edu) — a sample term-by-term schedule, seeded per the sample-schedule rule. Generic slots (MATH, FINE ART, HISTORY, SCIENCE WITH LAB, ENGL (LITERATURE COURSE), OPTION 1 OR 2, ELECTIVE, BUSN MAJOR ELECT, BUSN ELECTIVE) are choice:true with the flight plan's own wording; specific courses are not assigned by the source. Course titles for coded courses are from the official AUM 2023-2024 Undergraduate Catalog course descriptions. The flight plan does not list prerequisites, so no prereq chains are seeded. The flight plan does not categorize courses as core/major/elective, so category is omitted rather than invented. Semester credit totals match the flight plan's layout; plan total 120.
